hook: Meta's superintelligence lab just shipped its first frontier model.
map: Text, image, video and audio inputs
sections: Muse Wonder is a model for agents, coding, long workflows and multimodal reasoning.
Think of an airline launching a new long-haul jet with a huge cargo hold and lounges for every kind of passenger.
First, developers reach it through the Meta Model API and Muse Code. Second, Muse Wonder Full is offered by subscription only.
Before, Meta's lab had no frontier model in the market.
Now Meta has one, framed as a step to personal superintelligence under its safety framework.
Meta and AI chip and data-centre suppliers are the exposure. Benchmarks are company-reported. Our judgment: watch. Not financial advice.
